## Template selection

Please go to the "Preview" tab and select the appropriate template:

* Teams:
  * [I want to create a new team](?expand=1&template=add-team.md)
  * [I want to dissolve an existing team](?expand=1&template=remove-team.md)
* Members:
  * [I want to add a new member to an existing team](?expand=1&template=add-team-member.md)
  * [I want to remove a new member from an existing team](?expand=1&template=remove-team-member.md)
* [Anything else](?expand=1&template=general.md)
